title: Information Security & Privacy Program for Vehicle Inspection and Regulatory Data Systems
capability_statement: Parsons delivers an end-to-end Information Security and Privacy program tailored to vehicle inspection, regulatory, and citizen-facing data systems. Security is integrated from system design through development, daily operations, and maintenance, and is governed by a company-wide Cybersecurity Practice that serves federal and state government clients (including high-level, sensitive U.S. Government programs) and is reinforced on each program by dedicated security staff working alongside system and network administrators. The program addresses encryption of data at rest, in transit, and in use; identity and access management with least privilege provisioning, periodic access reviews, and termination-driven access disablement; multi-factor authentication, IP whitelisting, and geofencing for remote and administrative access; centralized endpoint management for production environments and limits on data exfiltration; system hardening to industry-accepted baselines (referencing CIS Benchmarks, DISA STIGs, and vendor configuration guides); audit logging and system monitoring; threat management combining antivirus and malware controls, firewall and intrusion detection, OS and database hardening, and secure communications; and a vulnerability and patch management cadence built on monthly internal and quarterly external vulnerability scans, prioritized remediation, documented verification, and security assessments tied to critical system changes. Cloud-hosted workloads operate on AWS infrastructure backed by AWS PCI-DSS attestations and supported by more than 100 in-house AWS certifications across Parsons engineering and security staff; complementary contact-center operations run with partners holding SOC 2 Type II and HITRUST CSF certifications. The program also covers breach response (24-hour notification, root-cause-driven corrective action, post-incident review, and law-enforcement liaison), data protection policy governance, SDLC security controls, third-party interconnection and compliance validation, and FIPS 140-2-aligned cryptographic standards for any data permitted on mobile devices.

named_past_performance.name: Pennsylvania I/M Program - Vehicle Information Inspection Database (VIID)
named_past_performance.scope: Cybersecurity for the Vehicle Information Inspection Database supporting more than 80 million transactions, including dedicated security staff, antivirus and malware controls, firewall and intrusion detection, database safeguarding, OS hardening, secure communication transmissions, monthly internal and quarterly external vulnerability scanning, security assessments during and after critical system changes, and use of the same scanning technology employed for high-level, sensitive U.S. Government programs.
named_past_performance.outcome: Sustained operation with no reported security or performance issue across more than 25 years of program delivery, supporting program uptime above 99.9% (with 99.99% cited for the VIID).

named_past_performance.name: Ontario Heavy-Duty Emissions Program AWS Cloud Migration (Ministry of the Environment, Conservation and Parks)
named_past_performance.scope: Migration of an integrated vehicle safety and emissions inspection program to the AWS cloud platform, including secure VIID development, information systems development, identity and access management, and ongoing operations support.
named_past_performance.outcome: Transitioned the program to AWS cloud with no service interruption and no impact to existing inspection stations, demonstrating secure cloud migration patterns reusable for similar programs.

named_past_performance.name: Contact Center Operations - Dasher Services, Inc. (subcontractor partner)
named_past_performance.scope: Help desk and contact center services for inspection program stakeholders, including security training for all team members, VoIP/internet-based call management with redundant internet providers and backup power, and a documented disaster recovery plan covering all critical systems.
named_past_performance.outcome: Operates under SOC 2 Type II and HITRUST Common Security Framework (CSF) certifications, both of which require a validated disaster recovery plan and provide independent assurance of security and privacy controls for contact-center workloads.

named_past_performance.outcome: More than 100 AWS certifications held by in-house engineers and security experts; AWS commitment secured to support program implementation and ongoing utilization, providing scalable, commercially highest-tier cybersecurity protections for hosted inspection workloads.
